verdict.rationale: The Wally CLI runs small local models offline and also reaches RunAnywhere's hosted Wally Cloud models through the same tools. A `--cloud` flag selects the hosted model, and hosted versus local execution is an explicit choice. The only cloud backend evidenced is RunAnywhere's own hosted service, not arbitrary third-party providers. Missing for 10: connecting to third-party cloud AI providers (e.g. bring-your-own API keys), documentation of mixing providers within the SDK interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.
